context.content: DSLR vs. Mirrorless is the endless battle. There's not one of them there's the best solution for everyone - it really depends on what you expect from your camera, and what you are willing to carry around. Also, cameras, mirrorless or DSLR, will get outdated eventually - not in such a way that it will render it useless at all, but advancements/improvements from Canon/Nikon/Sony etc. happen way faster in the camera body than it does in lenses. Realistically, a camera body will be "outdated" in 5+ years - again not making it useless, but in that timespan something new and revolutionary (or boredom) will have most people getting a new camera. But to make suggestions we really need to know your budget. And as mentioned above, what kind of photography do you want to do, which aspects of it appeals to you? Such as portraits, macro, landscape, wildlife, etc.
